rule: GO only if: every arm's TIMING rc 0 on the device; the sum over R1, M1_mutant, R3_domain of (steps_projected[1] x measured s/step x run_overhead 1.3 + that arm's measured process start-up) <= time left before the outer budget minus emit and checkpoint margins; every arm's nvidia-smi device-memory peak <= 0.8 x card total; every host RSS peak <= 10 GB. Otherwise rc 11: stop with the controls, calibration.json and nvidia-smi kept; no arm started. fits_time_lower_only reports when only the lower projections would fit (a decision for root/infra, not taken here). After GO the arms run in packet order; an arm whose own projection exceeds the time left when it would start is not started and is recorded so
